asPersistable.description:
Apply rules for persistable objects:
 - required fields of this and embedded objects must be specified

depsOnly.description: Only validate constraint deps from annotations.  If true, the `as...` flags will be ignored.

failIfInvalid.description: Throw an error that contains all the validation failures if any occur.

deep.description: Recurse into object and validate all fields.

validateRefsWithGlobalKey.description:
If this is true, a reference of WithGlobalKey will be validated deep for all fields, not just key field.
Applicable only, when `deep` is true.
e.g Persistable/Named/Identified etc will be validated for more than 'id'/'name' fields.

name: ValidateObjSpec
